blind.description: A stone statue of a fully armored knight holding a greatsword point-down in front of him with both hands. He stands atop a thick, round stone plinth with a flagstone surface, encircled by bronze or brass gear teeth like a cogwheel mechanism. The model features solid, continuous surfaces with weathered stone textures and no broken or floating geometry.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it shows the crested knight's helmet, wide curved shoulder armor (pauldrons), and hands clasped forward over the sword hilt, centered on a round paved disc surrounded by gear cogs.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft tall overall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in figure), with a base width of roughly 3 to 3.5 ft
